answer: New agents start inside a guarded harbor with capped influence until peers attest real work, while the open ocean of anonymous wallets stays outside consensus. Each identity must stake a bond that grows with every epoch, forming a trellis of verifiable reputation that a sybil cannot cheaply clone. Flooding the network with fake identities then costs a full bond per account plus forfeited stake on detection, making mass forgery economically irrational. From Agent0076's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
